result.instructions: Tools for Virtuous, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Virtuous data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run virtuous_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run virtuous_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run virtuous_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. virtuous_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: virtuous_get_current_organization
tools.title: Get the current organization
tools.description: Fetch the Virtuous organization this API key acts in — its name, time zone and culture, and whether the key's user is an administrator. A cheap way to confirm the key works. Virtuous: GET /api/Organization/Current.

tools.name: virtuous_search
tools.title: Global search
tools.description: Full-text search across contacts, individuals and entities (campaigns, projects, segments, tags) — the same search as the Virtuous search bar. Returns hits with highlights, grouped by kind. Virtuous: POST /api/Search.

query.description: Free-text search, e.g. a name, email or organization.

filter_types.description: Restrict to these kinds. Omit to search all.

tools.name: virtuous_search_contacts
tools.title: Search contacts
tools.description: Find contacts whose name, email, phone or address fully or partially matches a search string. Returns id, name, contact type, email, phone and address per match. Virtuous: POST /api/Contact/Search.

search.description: Text to match, e.g. "Weyland" or an email address.

tools.name: virtuous_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Fetch one contact (household, organization, foundation ...) with its address, giving summary (life-to-date, year-to-date, last gift), individuals and their contact methods, and custom fields. Virtuous: GET /api/Contact/{contactId}.

tools.name: virtuous_find_contact
tools.title: Find a contact by email or reference
tools.description: Look up a single contact by email address, or by an external reference (reference source + id, e.g. Stripe customer id). Give either email, or both reference_source and reference_id; if both are given Virtuous prioritises the reference. Virtuous: GET /api/Contact/Find.

reference_source.description: The reference source, e.g. Stripe, MailChimp, Shopify.

reference_id.description: The identifier within that reference source.

annotations.title: Find a contact by email or reference

tools.name: virtuous_list_contact_individuals
tools.title: List a contact's individuals
tools.description: List the individuals (people) that belong to a contact/household, with names, birth dates, and their emails and phones (contact methods). Virtuous: GET /api/ContactIndividual/ByContact/{contactId}.

tools.name: virtuous_list_contact_notes
tools.title: List a contact's notes
tools.description: List the notes logged on a contact — calls, meetings, emails and other touchpoints — with type, date, text and author. Virtuous: GET /api/ContactNote/ByContact/{contactId}.

tools.name: virtuous_list_contact_tags
tools.title: List a contact's tags
tools.description: List the tags applied to a contact (contactTagId, tagId, name). Virtuous: GET /api/ContactTag/ByContact/{contactId}.

tools.name: virtuous_list_contact_gifts
tools.title: List a contact's gifts
tools.description: List a contact's giving history: gift id, type, date, amount, segment and batch. Use virtuous_get_gift for designations and full detail. Virtuous: GET /api/Gift/ByContact/{contactId}.

tools.name: virtuous_get_gift
tools.title: Get a gift
tools.description: Fetch one gift in full: contact, type, date, amount and currency, batch, segment, grant, tribute, receipt date, designations to projects, premiums and custom fields. Virtuous: GET /api/Gift/{giftId}.

tools.name: virtuous_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the organization's tags (id, name, tag group). Use this to find a tagId before virtuous_add_contact_tag. Virtuous: GET /api/Tag.

tools.name: virtuous_search_projects
tools.title: Search projects
tools.description: Find projects (funds / designations gifts are given to) by name or code, with their balances, financial need and life-to-date giving. Virtuous: POST /api/Project/Search.

search.description: Text to match against project name or code.

tools.name: virtuous_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: Fetch one project: code, type, status, balances, financial need, date range, life-to-date and calendar-year giving and gift/giver counts. Virtuous: GET /api/Project/{projectId}.

tools.name: virtuous_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List the organization's events: name, type, location, start/end, invite and RSVP counts, attendance and total giving. Virtuous: GET /api/Event.

tools.name: virtuous_get_query_options
tools.title: Get query options
tools.description: List the parameters, their types, allowed operators and value options that virtuous_query accepts for one record type. Call this BEFORE building a query. Virtuous: GET /api/<Resource>/QueryOptions.

resource.description: Which Virtuous record type to query.

tools.name: virtuous_query
tools.title: Query records
tools.description: Run a Virtuous query-builder query against one record type (contacts, gifts, campaigns, projects, tasks, grants, pledges, recurring gifts, events ...). Conditions use parameter/operator names from virtuous_get_query_options. Returns { list, total }. For Contact and Gift, full_details returns full records instead of the abbreviated view. Virtuous: POST /api/<Resource>/Query.

resource.description: Which Virtuous record type to query.

groups.description: Condition groups, as in the Virtuous query builder. Omit for all records.

parameter.description: A parameter name from the QueryOptions tool, e.g. "Last Name".

operator.description: An operator allowed for that parameter, from QueryOptions, e.g. "Is".

value.description: The value to compare against (if the operator needs one).

secondaryValue.description: Second value, for range operators such as Between.

values.description: Several values, for operators that allow multiple values.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by (e.g. for gifts: Id, Amount, GiftDate, ReceiptDate, Batch).

include_archived.description: Contact queries only: include archived contacts.

full_details.description: Contact and Gift only: return full records (Query/FullContact, Query/FullGift).

tools.name: virtuous_create_contact_note
tools.title: Log a note on a contact
tools.description: Add a note to a contact's timeline — a call, meeting, visit or other touchpoint. Writes to the donor record. Virtuous: POST /api/ContactNote.

type.description: A contact note type configured in the organization.

note_date_time.description: When it happened, ISO 8601 (defaults to now).

annotations.title: Log a note on a contact

tools.name: virtuous_add_contact_tag
tools.title: Tag a contact
tools.description: Apply an existing tag to a contact (find the tagId with virtuous_list_tags). Virtuous: POST /api/ContactTag.

tools.name: virtuous_create_contact_transaction
tools.title: Submit a contact for import
tools.description: Submit a new or updated contact through Virtuous's import pipeline (the recommended way to add contacts). It is matched against existing contacts by name, email, phone, address and reference, bundled into an import at midnight, and only committed when a user reviews the import and clicks Run — so nothing is created in real time and no duplicates are forced. Virtuous: POST /api/Contact/Transaction.

reference_id.description: The contact's id in that system.

contact_type.description: Contact type, e.g. Household or Organization.

email_type.description: Email type as configured in Virtuous (see contact method types).

phone_type.description: Phone type as configured in Virtuous (see contact method types).

tags.description: Tag names to apply (Virtuous takes these as one string).

origin_segment_code.description: Code of the segment that brought this contact in.

email_lists.description: Email list names to subscribe the contact to.

tools.name: virtuous_create_gift_transaction
tools.title: Submit a gift for import
tools.description: Record a gift (donation already received) through Virtuous's gift import pipeline — the method Virtuous recommends. The gift is matched to a contact, recurring gift or pledge, held until the nightly import, and only created when a user reviews the import and clicks Run. This records a gift; it does NOT charge anyone. Identify the donor with contact.id, contact.referenceId, or name/email details. Virtuous: POST /api/v2/Gift/Transaction.

gift_type.description: Gift type as configured in Virtuous, e.g. "Cash".

referenceId.description: The donor's id in your system.

type.description: Contact type, e.g. Household or Organization.

contact.description: The donor. Virtuous matches this against existing contacts.

transaction_source.description: Where the gift came from, e.g. "Website".

transaction_id.description: The gift's id in that source (prevents double import).

frequency.description: For a recurring gift: its frequency as named in Virtuous.

segment.description: Segment code the gift is attributed to.
